description: FREE headline payability pre-check of one endpoint URL (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Validates the URL against the published target-URL policy only - no fetch is performed and no verdict is returned. The full signed reports are the paid payability_check and payability_memo calls.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

op.description: Optional op selection for the pre-check: 'check' (default) or 'memo'.

url.description: The one endpoint URL to grade. Fetched once at check time (twice, back to back, for the memo op) and never stored.

name: payability_precheck
